Details & specs ✦

🗄️
Where are my files?

In this browser's local storage (OPFS + IndexedDB). Export a ZIP backup anytime.

📱
Works on every device?

Phones, tablets, desktops — responsive grids, touch-safe menus, safe-area insets on iOS.

🎨
30 themes + Liquid Glass

11 standard + 19 premium palettes, remembered per account, with a site-wide glass toggle.

🌐
8 languages

EN · ES · FR · DE · PT · HI · AR · ZH — instant switching, flag chips, remembered.

🎬
Media superpowers

PiP, speed 0.25×–2×, repeat, volume boost, lyrics, scrub preview, cinema mode, video cutting.

🔐
Accounts & privacy

Local accounts + Guest mode. No tracking, no analytics, no server calls — ever.

⌨️
Keyboard shortcuts

Space/K, J/L, ←/→, ↑/↓, M, F, P… full list below.

🧹
Housekeeping

Trash with restore, History log, favorites, selection mode, custom folder icons.
